title: Use Stage3 validation retrieval mock dataset to extend stage3 validation retrieval: Retrieval Study 1
description_md:
## Hypothesis
Turn the insight `stage3 validation retrieval: Retrieval Study 1 treats insight extraction as a controlled node inside a larger research pipeline.` into a focused experiment on `Stage3 validation retrieval mock dataset`.

## Plan
- Reuse the dataset asset and its evaluation protocol.
- Translate the paper insight into one controlled experimental claim.
- Keep implementation scope small enough for stage3 experimentation.
expected_advantage: Should improve relevance or controllability on Stage3 validation retrieval mock dataset with limited implementation overhead.
risk_points: Insight-to-dataset mapping may be shallow without deeper literature review.
Dataset protocol may not fully cover the claimed innovation.
human_hints: keep the validation pipeline small and controlled
